records.name: Quests
records.summary: Optional task chains involving NPCs, items, combat and area unlocks. The wiki reports 21 total quests.

records.name: Achievements
records.summary: Optional challenges that can grant Sleep Points or combat damage bonuses.

records.name: Coins
records.summary: Primary in-game currency used for shops, travel and other purchases.

records.name: Trading
records.summary: Player-to-player item exchange mechanics.

records.name: Sleep Points
records.summary: Activity resource consumed by skilling/combat. Sleeping in a bed restores the player's current Sleep Point maximum; achievements can increase capacity.

records.name: Armour
records.summary: Equipment sets provide combat-style defence/damage bonuses and may have environment or set-specific effects.

records.name: Tools
records.summary: Skill tools such as pickaxes, axes and fishing equipment gate or improve gathering actions.

records.name: Monsters
records.summary: Combat enemies with HP, damage, accuracy, defences, weaknesses and drop tables.

records.name: Fermenting
records.summary: Brewing-related time/process mechanic for fermented products.

records.name: Treasure Maps
records.summary: Treasure-map/chest system with rewards including coins, resources, rings and rare equipment.

records.name: Bundles
records.summary: Collection/completion mechanic requiring sets of items or objectives.

records.name: Sigils
records.summary: Equipable/collectible sigil mechanic with special effects.

records.name: Shops
records.summary: NPC shops across regions sell skill supplies, equipment and other goods.

records.name: Pets
records.summary: Collectible pet system tied to activities and drops.

records.name: Hardcore
records.summary: Alternative account/game mode with additional restrictions and rules.

records.name: Minigames
records.summary: Side activities with their own objectives, rewards and progression.

records.name: Levels
records.summary: Skill-level progression and XP thresholds.

records.name: Gems
records.summary: Gem items and related powers/crafting/enchantment uses.

records.name: Spirits
records.summary: Spirit-related activities/rewards.

records.name: Archeology
records.summary: Archeology-related activity/content.
